# Fig 6. Convergent evidence

This figure integrates the two independent lines of evidence: community assembly processes (βNTI / RCbray) and microbial co-occurrence networks.

## Load results

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
```

## Panel A — βNTI by group

```{r}

pA <- readRDS("rds/assembly_process/bntiplot.rds")
pA
```

## Panel B — Assembly process composition

```{r}

pB <- readRDS("rds/assembly_process/rcplot.rds")
pB
```

## Panel C — Network metrics vs depth (from fjbalvino)

```{r}

# TODO: depth-trend panel from collaborator's network results.
#       e.g. metrics vs depth horizon with trend line.
pC <- NULL  # placeholder
```

## Assemble figure

```{r}
fig6left <- plot_grid(pA, pB,
                  labels = c("a)","b)"),
                  label_fontface = "bold",
                  ncol = 1)
fig6left
```

```{r}
fig6 <- plot_grid(fig6left, pC,
                  labels = c("","c)"),
                  label_fontface = "bold",
                  ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(0.4, 0.6))
fig6
```

```{r}
ggsave2("Figures/Fig6.pdf", fig6, width = 35, height = 25, units = "cm")
```
